newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Megaworld hits intra-day high in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Megaworld hits intra-day high in late trade.

text.p: Manila real estate firm Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc hit an intra-day high of 6.40 pesos in late trade on Monday rising by 70 centavos or 12.28 percent on a technical rebound, brokers said.
"It's just technical as it has been going down sharply," said Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Securities Corp.
"They have been sold down for so long that the trend has to be broken," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
Megaworld and its housing arm, Empire East Land Holdings Inc have been badly hit by fears of an oversupply in the property sector.
Empire also climbed by 40 centavos, or 8.70 percent, to five pesos late in the session.
Megaworld was among the top 10 most heavily traded stocks with turnover of 74.0 million pesos.
